description: A driven team of young tech innovators and problem solvers passionate about AI, data science, and space technology. We are dedicated to leveraging open NASA datasets to build smart, scalable solutions that detect Earth system trends and address critical environmental challenges
summary: Our project introduces an intelligent, advanced system designed to investigate Earth system trends and detect environmental and climate anomalies with high precision. By leveraging satellite data processing combined with artificial intelligence algorithms and Edge AI models, the system identifies rapid shifts in vegetation, surface temperatures, and water resources in real-time. This solution addresses the challenge by providing environmental researchers and decision-makers with an interactive, rapid tool to predict ecological risks before they escalate. The significance of this project lies in empowering local communities and scientists to make proactive, data-driven decisions to protect ecosystems and ensure sustainable Earth resources
details:
Our project, EdgeSentinel AI, introduces an intelligent and advanced system based on satellite data processing to monitor Earth system trends and detect environmental and climate anomalies with high precision.

Functionality and How It Works: The project integrates artificial intelligence algorithms and Edge AI models to analyze satellite data and NASA sensors in real-time, detecting rapid changes in vegetation, surface temperatures, and water resources.

Benefits and Desired Impact: The system enables researchers and decision-makers to monitor and anticipate environmental risks proactively, protecting ecosystems and supporting sustainability.

Tools and Languages Used: We utilized modern programming technologies (such as Python and Go), geospatial data analysis libraries, and AI algorithms to process big data efficiently at the network edge.

Creative Aspect and Factors Considered: The system is designed to operate efficiently even under limited internet connectivity conditions thanks to Edge computing technologies, focusing on ease of use and providing an accurate interactive interface that translates complex data into clear, actionable insights immediately to protect planet Earth
